intention: Every Windows cairn box runs PostgreSQL as an automatic Windows service on 127.0.0.1:5432, with a LOGIN CREATEDB role for the OS user, a pgpass in db_domain's instance space (~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass), and a store.connect() that reaches the cairn database, so a bus (live or scratch) comes up on Windows and asks CodeMother instead of dying at its transit table.

apply.note: Complete recipe, written to option (B): a Windows service, because 11.3.5 makes PostgreSQL a host service that Recovery installs and upgrades (winget upgrade carries it), not a portable copy. Steps 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 run as the user with no elevation; step 2 is the ONE command Akien runs, and its only elevation is the installer's own UAC prompt. No secret is ever on a command line: step 1 generates both passwords into files, the installer reads the superuser one from --optionfile, step 3 passes the role's as a bound parameter. Each step is idempotent. Mirrors akiendell, measured 2026-11-14: postgresql-x64-17 Running/Automatic, pgpass present.
apply.1_secrets:
CC, unprivileged. Writes ~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass (lines 127.0.0.1:5432:*:postgres:<generated> and 127.0.0.1:5432:*:<USERNAME>:<generated>; kept if already present) and pg_install.options (superpassword, serverport=5432, disable-components=stackbuilder):
"$HOME/.cairn/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -I - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, secrets
d = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cairn" / "devices" / "db_domain" / "0"
d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p = d / "pgpass"
if not p.is_file():
    s, r = secrets.token_urlsafe(24), secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    p.write_text(f"127.0.0.1:5432:*:postgres:{s}\n127.0.0.1:5432:*:{os.environ['USERNAME']}:{r}\n")
s = next(l.split(":", 4)[4] for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.split(":")[3] == "postgres")
(d / "pg_install.options").write_text(f"superpassword={s}\nserverport=5432\ndisable-components=stackbuilder\n")
print("pgpass and pg_install.options written under", d)
PY
apply.2_install:
AKIEN, the one elevated step, typed at the CC prompt (bash) and approved at UAC:
! winget install --id PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL.17 -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --override "--mode unattended --unattendedmodeui none --optionfile $(cygpath -w ~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pg_install.options)"
apply.3_role:
CC, unprivileged. As postgres over TCP with the pgpass, CREATE (or ALTER) ROLE <USERNAME> LOGIN CREATEDB with the generated password, bound as a parameter. libpq's default user on Windows is the OS user, which is what store.connect() sends:
"$HOME/.cairn/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -I - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, psycopg2
from psycopg2 import sql
p = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cairn" / "devices" / "db_domain" / "0" / "pgpass"
me = os.environ["USERNAME"]
pw = next(l.split(":", 4)[4] for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.split(":")[3] == me)
c = psycopg2.connect(host="127.0.0.1", port=5432, dbname="postgres", user="postgres", passfile=str(p))
c.autocommit = True
cur = c.cursor()
cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = %s", (me,))
verb = "ALTER" if cur.fetchone() else "CREATE"
cur.execute(sql.SQL(verb + " ROLE {} LOGIN CREATEDB PASSWORD %s").format(sql.Identifier(me)), (pw,))
print(verb, "ROLE", me, "LOGIN CREATEDB")
c.close()
PY
apply.4_database:
CC, unprivileged. store.connect() self-provisions the cairn database and its owner registry (ensure_database, _ensure_registry):
"$HOME/.cairn/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -c 'from cairn.devices.db_domain.tools.client import store; store.connect().close()'
apply.5_cleanup: CC. rm ~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pg_install.options (the superuser password stays only in pgpass). Add a pointer, never the value, in ~/.akien/akien.credentials.cfg under a PostgreSQL group: '<box> postgres superuser and <USERNAME> role: file:~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass'.
apply.6_reverify: CC. Run the verify twice; then bring up scratch_bus.launch('codemother') and record the first step past the database that fails, if any.

verify.command: py="$HOME/.cairn/venv/Scripts/python.exe"; "$py" -c 'import socket,sys; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(3); sys.exit(s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1",5432)))' </dev/null || { echo 'RED: nothing on 5432 (no listener at 127.0.0.1:5432)'; exit 1; }; svc=$(sc.exe query type= service state= all | sed -n 's/^SERVICE_NAME: \(postgresql-x64-[0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$svc" ] || { echo 'RED: something listens on 5432 but no postgresql-x64-* service is installed'; exit 1; }; sc.exe query "$svc" | grep -q RUNNING || { echo "RED: service $svc is not RUNNING"; exit 1; }; sc.exe qc "$svc" | grep -q AUTO_START || { echo "RED: service $svc does not start automatically"; exit 1; }; [ -s "$HOME/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass" ] || { echo 'RED: no pgpass at ~/.cairn/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass'; exit 1; }; out=$("$py" -c 'from cairn.devices.db_domain.tools.client import store; c=store.connect(); cur=c.cursor(); cur.execute("select current_user"); print(cur.fetchone()[0]); c.close()' </dev/null 2>&1) || { echo "RED: store.connect() failed: $(printf %s "$out" | tail -1)"; exit 1; }; echo "green: $svc running and automatic on 5432, pgpass present, store.connect() as $out"
